profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (low confidence, mostly co-authored)
summary: Navotas representative with about 59 principal-authored bills. Authored income-tax exemption for senior citizens, a higher individual income-tax exemption threshold, VAT exemption for households and petroleum excise suspension. Co-authored national minimum wage, teacher salary-grade upgrades, farmer loan condonation, gig-economy regulation, a diesel price ceiling, estate tax abolition and right-to-information bills.
caveat: Most economic evidence is co-authored and includes an estate tax abolition (+2) that offsets relief bills. Right-to-information is a single co-authored issue, so democratic institutions is not scored.
